scripts.check: pnpm sdk:assert:registry && pnpm build:all && pnpm lint:all && pnpm test:all
scripts.package:cli:dev: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --dir apps/inheriti-cli package:dev
scripts.package:cli:stg: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --dir apps/inheriti-cli package:stg
scripts.package:cli:prod: pnpm --filter "./packages/*" run build && pnpm --dir apps/inheriti-cli package:prod
scripts.package:all: pnpm sdk:assert:registry && pnpm build:all && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" run package
scripts.release:all: pnpm sdk:assert:registry && pnpm build:all && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" run release
